preprocessing_steps.Description: anti-aliasing filter (25 Hz), notch filter (50 Hz), downsampling to 100 Hz, bad channel interpolation, eye artifact subtraction (SGEYESUB algorithm), removal of frontal (AF) row channels, high-pass filter (0.18 Hz), common average re-reference, pops and drifts attenuation (HEAR algorithm), low-pass filter (3 Hz), downsampling to 20 Hz

TaskDescription: [continuous 2D trajectory decoding] Attempted movement paradigm: participants instructed to attempt lower arm movement as if wielding a computer mouse while arm was strapped to armrest. Two task types: snakeruns (target tracking) and freeruns (self-paced shape tracing). Offline calibration followed by online feedback in 50% and 100% EEG feedback conditions. Trial duration: 23.0s.
Instructions: Track snake with gaze and simultaneously attempt movement of strapped lower arm/hand as if wielding computer mouse; for freeruns: trace static shapes at own pace
InstitutionName: Institute of Neural Engineering, Graz University of Technology
Description: Continuous 2D trajectory decoding from attempted movement: across-session performance in able-bodied and feasibility in a spinal cord injured participant
